Subject: Private Connect: network clearance & provisioning timeline

Hi Amelia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can scope the Private VPC onboarding with your NetOps team.

Summary from our discussion:
- You confirmed Argentum prefers a Private VPC deployment (PrivateLink preferred) for regulatory isolation.
- Key constraints: outbound egress must originate from a small set of static IPs, connections must pass through your firewall stack, and we need SOC2 evidence for data handling.
- Timeline target: proof-of-concept in your staging environment within 4 weeks.

Immediate asks for NetOps (see attached checklist):
1) Confirm whether PrivateLink or VPC peering is required by your infra/security team. If PrivateLink, please share the AWS account IDs and VPC endpoint policy constraints.
2) Provide an allowlist of CIDRs / static egress IPs we should publish (we can host static egress via NAT in the dedicated connector).
3) Firewall/port requirements: we typically need outbound TLS to 443 and optional mTLS for health checks on port 8443 — confirm any inbound restrictions.
4) Point of contact for cert provisioning and KMS/HSM questions (if you plan to bring your own key).

Attachments: redwood_private_deploy_checklist.pdf (checklist + sample firewall rules), argnet_network_matrix.xlsx (template for your network team).

Proposed next steps:
- Marissa to run a short readiness checklist with your NetOps; Ben will prepare a staging deployment plan with IPs and timelines.
- Can your NetOps do a short technical sync Wed 7/31 at 9:30am PT? If not, tell us a couple of windows.

Please loop in whoever owns PrivateLink endpoints on your side. Happy to adjust the checklist based on your policies.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
(h) 415-555-0132 | hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai

Thanks Hannah — useful recap. Looping in our NetOps alias; I'll also add Derrick (our cloud security lead) if needed. A few quick answers to unblock initial planning: 

- Preference: PrivateLink if possible due to our segmentation policy. We need the endpoint in our mgmt VPC only (will not be routable to other prod VPCs).
- Egress IPs: we'll need the full list of egress IPs to create the allowlist — can you give an initial estimate (range/count) so we can raise the firewall change?
- Ports: TLS 443 yes; we do not accept any inbound on 8443 from external accounts. Health checks should be over the PrivateLink interface.
- Certs/KMS: we use AWS KMS CMKs; we need to know if Redwood will bring a key or we should provide access for encryption in transit for stored artifacts.

Wed 7/31 9:30am PT is okay for a 30-min call with NetOps. Derrick will join if we need to talk KMS.

Thanks,
Amelia
Amelia Torres
VP Product, Argentum Financial
amelia.torres@argentum.com

Hi team — Marissa from Redwood Ops here. Thanks for confirming the PrivateLink preference. A couple of operational clarifications before tomorrow's sync so we can come prepared: 

1) Egress IPs: for staging we can push a small set (4) of static egress IPs. For production, we typically publish a pool (8–16 IPs) depending on throughput. Can you indicate whether a 4-IP staging allowlist is acceptable?

2) VPC endpoint policy: if you host the endpoint in a mgmt VPC and restrict principals, we can provide a sample JSON policy. Do you need us to pre-populate with Redwood's service principals?

3) TLS mutual auth: we support mTLS for health and admin channels. If Argentum does not allow inbound 8443, we will bind health checks over the PrivateLink interface — no public inbound required.

4) Certs/KMS: for POC, we can use Redwood-managed keys; for Prod we recommend customer-managed CMK. If Derrick can share the KMS key ARN or the list of required IAM principals, we will validate.

I've attached a short netops intake workbook (argnet_network_matrix.xlsx) — if your team can fill columns A–F before the call, we'll use that to populate the SOW.

Looking forward to the 9:30am PT sync. I'll send a calendar invite with dial-in + short agenda.

Cheers,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Customer Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference
